text:
Alex: Short thread: pick publish strategy for JS SDK. Single package + conditional exports or split edge package? Need Node CJS, Node ESM, and Edge support + TS typings. Thoughts?

Priya: Single package with an exports map. Build dist/index.cjs, dist/index.mjs, dist/edge.mjs. Exports route import->mjs, require->cjs, ./edge->edge.mjs. Keep top-level "types": "./dist/index.d.ts".

Han: Agrees. Key gotchas: editors won't resolve subpath types unless we either expose subpaths in exports and ship per-subpath .d.ts or have index.d.ts re-export runtime types. Recommend re-export approach to avoid enumerating every path.

Alex: CI must pack the tarball and run smoke tests: node require import, node esm import, and a miniflare worker import. pkg-bot should block publish if any step fails.

pkg-bot: pack check failed on last publish: missing dist/index.mjs. Please include .mjs and .d.ts in package files.

Priya: I'll update rollup/tsc outputs and files globs. Also add README examples for require/import/edge to reduce onboarding friction.

Han: Add an editors/types test that imports types from top-level and from ./edge to confirm resolution.

Alex: Great. Single package + conditional exports + CI tarball smoke tests. I'll open PR and tag reviewers.
